summary: HUD visual-state transition with noise-modulated alpha/scale. When the byte at this+0x1C58 differs from the incoming state a2, it stores a2. If the HUD activation dword at this+0x1F00 is nonzero and a3 is 0, it indexes two lookup tables through a shared byte counter (dword_8AAE70, post-incremented twice): a noise table (flt_8AB274) feeds scale v8 = noise*0.1 + 1.0 and a trig table (flt_8AAE74) feeds alpha v7 = 1.0 - trig*0.15000001, then calls HUDElementConfig(40, 2, v7, v8). Returns a2 normally, or a3 on the HUD-config path.

local_names.result: returned value (a2, or a3 on HUD path)

operations.description: Only proceed if the byte at this+0x1C58 differs from the incoming state a2; otherwise return a2 unchanged.
Store the new state a2 into the byte at this+0x1C58.
Only proceed if the dword at this+0x1F00 (HUD element activation flag) is nonzero.
Only proceed on the noise-modulated HUD path when a3 is 0; otherwise return a3.
v4 = flt_8AB274 indexed by byte value of dword_8AAE70, then dword_8AAE70 post-incremented (noise sample).
v6 = flt_8AAE74 indexed by byte value of dword_8AAE70, then dword_8AAE70 post-incremented a second time (trig sample).
Compute scale v8 = noise*0.1 + 1.0 and alpha v7 = 1.0 - trig*0.15000001.
Call HUDElementConfig with element id 40, sub-type 2, and the computed alpha v7 / scale v8; return its result.
Return result (a2 when the state byte was unchanged or the HUD flag was clear, a3 when the noise path was skipped by the a3 test).
